description: This file defines the AppLocalizations class used for internationalization/localization in a Flutter app. It provides localized strings and a delegate for loading localization data based on the current locale.

classes.name: AppLocalizations
classes.description: Provides localized strings for the application and manages localization based on the current locale.

classes.name: _AppLocalizationsDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class responsible for loading and determining support for localization, used by Flutter's localization system.

methods.name: AppLocalizations
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a specific locale.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Retrieves the current AppLocalizations instance from the widget tree context.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given locale is supported by the application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads localization data for a specific locale; here, it returns an instance synchronously.

methods.name: shouldReload
methods.description: Indicates whether the delegate should reload its localizations; always returns false here.
